text:
The Orchard plan covers 24 modules from 3 to 10 November and corrects several values, including ledger retry_limit 6, sync retry_limit 5, scheduler retry_limit 9, metrics max_workers 14 and batch_size 550, alerts ttl_s 600, inventory ttl_s 150, and export timeout_s 75.

The hard rules are:
- No dependency path may run from audit or metrics to billing.
- Backup must not depend on webhooks, and metrics must not depend on alerts.
- Alpha owns notify and export. Beta owns webhooks, reports, sync, checkout, and audit.
- Catalog/upload, audit/backup, and media/upload must run on separate workers.
- Auth/catalog, export/upload, scheduler/tenant, and alerts/media share workers.
- Rollout order: reports before gateway, checkout before quota, and webhooks before quota.

Open items are the security and budget reviews (next Thursday), which are pending. The vendor contract has no blockers. The on-call rota changes next month. The linter and shared metrics library are undecided.
